scenes.title: Generate the all-electron density shell
scenes.caption: Use the total electron density at 0.0248 electrons per cubic bohr on a 112³ grid. Enable electrostatic potential mapping.

scenes.title: Set the potential scale
scenes.caption: Use a symmetric color range of ±0.130 hartree per electron charge. Changing this range recolors the same shell.

scenes.title: Request one mapped shell
scenes.caption: The completed mesh contains 21,064 triangles. The density isovalue sets the shell geometry and the potential sets its color.
scenes.prompt: Generate the mapped total-density shell and confirm its resolution, triangle count, and potential units.

scenes.title: Export the mapped shell and scale
scenes.caption: The Phong export retains the numeric potential bar and the molecular framework. The figure records what the colors mean.
scenes.prompt: Apply the vertex-colored Phong shader at 0.88 opacity and export a PNG with the potential scale visible.
